main_window.title: {app_name}  v{version}
main_window.preserve_structure_tooltip:
Preserve Structure:
Recreates the original website's directory structure on your disk.

url_input.placeholder: Enter website URL to scan for files...
url_input.recursive_tooltip:
Recursive Scan:
Follows links on the same domain to find files across multiple pages.
url_input.depth_tooltip: Maximum link depth to follow when recursively exploring a site.
url_input.max_pages_tooltip:
Maximum number of unique pages to crawl per scan.
High values may significantly increase scan time.
url_input.restrict_to_path_tooltip:
Restrict to Path:
Only follows links that start with the same directory as the initial URL.
url_input.page_limit_warning: Page limit reached ({limit} pages). Some directories may not have been scanned. Increase the limit in the 'Max Pages' field above for the next scan.
url_input.max_files_tooltip:
Limit the number of files to download.
Useful to avoid downloading all episodes of a podcast, for example.
∞ (0) = unlimited.
url_input.delay_tooltip:
Delay between HTTP requests (seconds).
Higher values are more polite to the server but slower.

settings_dialog.title: Settings
settings_dialog.scan_options_text:
Scan Options Explained

Recursive Scan: Follows links on the same domain to find files across multiple pages.

Restrict to Path: Only follows links that start with the same directory as the initial URL.

Preserve Structure: Recreates the original website's directory structure on your disk.
settings_dialog.language_restart: Language changes will be applied when you restart the application.

about_dialog.title: About {app_name}
about_dialog.privacy_tooltip: Only connects to the internet for the specific content you request.
about_dialog.description: {app_name} is a privacy-first tool that scans web pages and lets you preview, filter, and download files by type. All operations are local: the app only connects to the internet to retrieve the specific content you request.
about_dialog.step1_desc: Paste the website URL you want to scan for files.
about_dialog.step2_desc: The app scans the page (and subpages if recursive) and shows all found files. Filter by type.
about_dialog.step3_desc: Check the files you want to download. Use Select All or filter by category.
about_dialog.step4_desc: Choose destination folder and download. Track progress per file and overall.
about_dialog.feature_filters: File type filters — PDF, images, audio, video, documents, archives
about_dialog.feature_recursive: Recursive crawling — follow links to find files across pages
about_dialog.feature_batch: Batch download — multiple files with progress tracking
about_dialog.feature_destination: Custom destination — choose where to save files
about_dialog.tagline: Building tools with respect for user privacy.
about_dialog.offline_desc: Only connects when you request content

tree_dialog.title: Directory Tree Analysis
tree_dialog.hint: Shows every directory found during the scan, with file counts and types.

direct_scan.tooltip:
Direct Download:
For file servers (Apache/nginx directory indexes).
Downloads ALL files and subdirectories with no limits.
Preserves the original folder structure.
direct_scan.auto_download_tooltip:
Download all files directly without showing the preview table.
Files will be saved to the selected destination folder.

scan_modes.web_tooltip:
Scan web pages for files.
Configure recursion, depth, and limits.
scan_modes.rss_tooltip:
Scan RSS/Atom feeds.
Shows all episodes for manual selection.
scan_modes.direct_tooltip:
Direct download from file servers (Apache/nginx).
Downloads everything with no limits.
